HTTP 400 'DEGRADED function cannot be invoked': NIM marks individual tool/function IDs DEGRADED after repeated errors/timeouts in a sliding window; lockout persists for the whole session (new session mints a fresh id). Mitigations (log-28 2026-07-07): 1 tool call per turn, 3-8s cooldown, <6K output tokens/turn in tool-rich agents, switch model after 2 consecutive 4xx.
NIM validation: 'thinking.type' must be 'enabled' or 'disabled' — requests without the param 400 (log-28 2026-07-07).
